## Interactions

Behaviour that is not a property of this part alone. Each interaction names the records it spans, the conditions it holds under, and how far it has been confirmed. An interaction that spans several parts appears on every one of their pages, under the same identifier, because it is equally a fact about each.

### int-jst-board-map

<EvidenceAnchor id="int-jst-board-map" />

- **Records involved:** `rec-jst-b6b-xh-a` (this record)
- **Conditions:** Assert the locked #90 A-to-B interface contract exactly: J4 (board-a) pins 1-2 = +15V (Board A VBUS\_OUT, post-Q1-load-switch, paired A->B conductors), 3 = ATT (STUSB4500 U1.11/ATTACH, open-drain active-low, no on-board pull-up), 4 = PDOK (STUSB4500 U1.20/POWER\_OK2, open-drain active-low, asserts on a live PDO2 15V contract), 5-6 = GND (paired return). J5 (board-b) carries the identical pinout as the mating end of the same cable -- unlike the led-lamp port's Board P/Board L split, zudo-pd's contract is uniform at both ends. Verify pin-1 orientation on both layouts and end-to-end cable continuity before interconnecting boards; the connector's mechanical polarization and single-6-position-XH uniqueness rule (board-split-decision.md Keying/foolproofing) prevent a wrong-header mate, but not a miswired cable.
- **Verdict:** NEEDS BENCH

**Facts this rests on:**

- [`fact-jst-b6b-xh-a-identity`](#fact-jst-b6b-xh-a-identity)
- [`fact-jst-b6b-xh-a-dimensions`](#fact-jst-b6b-xh-a-dimensions)
- [`fact-jst-b6b-xh-a-locked-contract`](#fact-jst-b6b-xh-a-locked-contract)

### int-jst-harness-bench

<EvidenceAnchor id="int-jst-harness-bench" />

- **Records involved:** `rec-jst-b6b-xh-a` (this record)
- **Conditions:** With power absent, inspect mating latch/key, tug-test every crimp, continuity-test all six conductors end-to-end, verify no adjacent shorts and duplicate power/ground conductors, then current-limit first power and check connector/wire temperature under maximum intended load (worst-case 3.0 A PD-contract cap against the 1.6x/2.0x derated/nameplate margin).
- **Verdict:** NEEDS BENCH

**Facts this rests on:**

- [`fact-jst-b6b-xh-a-current`](#fact-jst-b6b-xh-a-current)
